role: One fixed new-date confirmation of the exported matched-fallback policy; no test-based selection

score_protocol.note: Reuse the exact existing50K packet and native producer; old candidate selection is not used for prediction

routing.rule: SHA256 first8bytes big-endian modulo3; corresponding frozen encoder per route

evaluation.conditions: For both: positive aggregate conditional CI; aggregate point gain>0 in each seed and each routing group; all seven point guards pass
evaluation.decisions: One full50000-slate test after all350000 real decisions pass source/response audits; no early baseline metrics, adaptive sample extension, checkpoint or threshold changes

limitations: Logged-exposure pseudo-slates are not unexposed retrieval candidates or an online randomized experiment.
Routing groups use overlapping training cohorts; conditional bootstrap does not capture all training uncertainty.
Point guards do not prove every objective improves or simultaneous population noninferiority.
This is a new prospective evaluator for models fixed before any performance on the reserved dates; earlier36K results remain exploratory.
